query: SHOW INDEXES YIELD name, state, labelsOrTypes, properties WHERE name = 'gsp_cost_lookup' RETURN name, state, labelsOrTypes, properties
MATCH (u:GspAnchor) RETURN u.uid AS uid, u.keep AS keep
MATCH (:GspAnchor {uid: 1})-[:GSP_EXPAND]->(x:GspLeaf) WHERE x.mark = true RETURN count(x) AS count
MATCH (:GspAnchor {uid: 2})-[:GSP_EXPAND]->(x:GspLeaf) WHERE x.mark = true RETURN count(x) AS count
MATCH (u:GspAnchor) WHERE coalesce(u.keep, false) = false MATCH (u)-[:GSP_EXPAND]->(v:GspLeaf) RETURN count(v) AS count
MATCH (u:GspAnchor)-[:GSP_REFERENCE]->(v:GspLeaf) WHERE NOT EXISTS { MATCH (u)-[:GSP_EXPAND]->(v) } RETURN count(v) AS count
